note: #131, docs/training-plans.md sections 5 (L2, L2b) and 6: a worn-out user asks for a lighter week; the coach proposes one lighter-week change (fewer or shorter sessions at the same or lower effort) for that week only, as a proposal, with calm wording and no invented number for how much lighter (deload_factor needs a source). Same seed as plan_change_only_diff; next week is week 1 (in-memory ids: Thursday's tempo run 2, Saturday's long run 3).

known_bad.source: Written for this case: an applied change with an invented research number.
known_bad.why: Says the plan is already updated and quotes a 40% cut as research-backed, although nothing changes before Accept and L2b has no sourced number.
known_bad.answer: No problem, I've cut next week by 40%, which research shows is optimal for recovery. Your plan is updated.

question: I'm really worn out lately. Can you make next week lighter?

propose_plan_change.reason: A lighter week while you're worn out.

must: Present the lighter week as a proposal the user accepts in the app, not as done
Respond to being worn out calmly and without blame
must_not: Say or imply the plan has already been changed or saved
Propose a new plan, or change weeks other than next week
Quote a percentage or number for how much lighter as if research backs it
